title: Playing a jazz concert with Gene Krupa at NYU
summary: Krupa came to NYU for a jazz concert and Handy and a clarinetist were found to play with him; later Krupa did not remember him.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: (Side A of Tape 1 ended at this point. Transcript will continue with Side B.)
You were about twenty years old?
Yes.
And ready to strike out?
I was twenty in 1940. Right, it was about '38 at this time.
While I was downstairs, the Benny Goodman Trio, Gene Krupa and Benny and Teddy Wilson were very big, and Krupa came down to N.Y.U. to give a jazz concert.

He came down alone so they searched through the school to find a clarinet player and a piano player and they found me and another guy and we played the thing with Gene. I remember calling him a few years after that, when he formed
his own band; he didn't remember me. I never got to join his band.
What did they ask you to do to get a clarinet player and a piano player, to do the Benny Goodman charts?

He came down and said let's do one chorus of "Idaho", then give me two stop choruses and clarinet take one and then we'll all go out with one, and he named a few tunes to try and find out what we knew. I didn't know the clarinet player and he didn't know me, we had no idea, but we put it together and it was a fun day.
That was your first brush with the big time?
Right. That was it.
Krupa was not very old then either, was he? I've forgotten his age. He's older than you but not a hell of a lot.
No, probably by about six, seven years.
He was about twenty-
No, I think he was about ten years older than me. He's gone now, isn't he? Of course Gene's gone.
He's gone ten years or more.
I keep forgetting how many guys are gone. They kept dropping year by year.
He worked hard on dropping year by year.
A lot of us did. I'm really astonished that I still haven't. I never would have believed in my early days that I would have gone passed thirty.
We'll get into that later on.
I'm not really getting into anything.
I want to ask about some of that later on. Was there any response in you to
play in this gig with Krupa? Did you say now it's time for me to go out and get on that level?
